scope.target: v0.14.0 release record, notes, migration, phase contract, support matrix, route evidence, package identity, release validators, and UPG-003 terminal evidence
constraints: Use exactly one online Issue #206 and this one technical workflow across S1, S2, and S3.
Use the exact Included Work snapshot #200 through #208 in order; #209 remains traceability-only.
Prove one-entrypoint routes for v0.13.0, v0.9.0, and v0.6.0 without manual sequential application.
Keep release and workflow records source-only; do not place them in downstream provenance or packages.
Keep #206 open until the admitted S3 PR merges and keep coordination Issue #222 open.
Do not claim Project-field restoration from this workflow.
non_goals: Create or modify a GitHub Release
Modify an external repository or local historical backlog/roadmap

architecture_decisions: S1 owns read-only route resolution and S2 owns target-local transaction semantics; S3 supplies exact release assets and proof rather than reimplementing them.
Concrete release support matrix and route evidence remain source-only under .dev/releases/v0.14.0.
Candidate source validation and post-merge provider closure are separate evidence boundaries.
user_constraints: Release notes may mention #209 only as a defect correction.
The S3 PR terminal-closes #206 and defers coordination Issue #222.
No tag, Release, asset/package publication, nightly activation, Project restoration, or external mutation.

Commit, independently audit, pass hosted checks, terminal-close #206, and read back integration.
